arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transactions_over_500_credit FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.card_type = 'Credit' AND t.amount_usd_cents > 50000
arguments.explanation: Counts transactions over $500 made with credit cards, the same measure as the prepaid-debit count.
assumptions: 'Over $500' means amount_usd_cents > 50000, matching the earlier query.
Credit cards means card_type = 'Credit' only, excluding 'Debit' and 'Debit (Prepaid)'.
The count covers all transactions in the data, labelled or not, as the earlier query did.
